text:
maria_support: ACME reporting a sustained 504 wave hitting hosted-inference edge for embeddings batch traffic. They say it started ~14:02 UTC, ~10% of requests start failing with 504s on streaming endpoints.

jordan_sre: Thanks — do we have a sample request/trace id? Any common headers or content-size? Can you drop logs from frontdoor? :eyes:

maria_support: Provided sample trace id in ticket: trace=acme-emb-20260212-7f9e. Sample curl they used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1","inputs":[...500 items...]}' \
  https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/embeddings
```
responses intermittently return 504 Gateway Timeout with no body.

vivian_eng: I pulled edge logs (frontdoor/envoy) from eu1 -> seeing repeated upstream timeout for midproxy cluster: "upstream response timeout" and a backlog of pending streams. Also see many `connection closed before end of request` during same window.

alex_prodops: Any CPU/memory spikes on midproxy or ingress pods? Could be conn pool exhaustion.

jordan_sre: Quick metrics snapshot: midproxy p95 latency spiked, envoy upstream_rq_pending_overflow increased, and active connections peaked. I suspect blocking writes from large embed responses are thrashing proxy buffers and causing head-of-line stalls.

maria_support: Customer says payload sizes aren't huge per item, but batch size is 500. They can repro by sending batched embeddings in loops.

vivian_eng: Repro steps I used (local):
```
# fortio replay of 300 concurrent clients sending batched embed requests
fortio load -c 300 -n 500 -qps 0 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -m POST -t 30s https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/embeddings
```
Result: tail 504s after ~2 minutes, frontdoor worker goroutines pegged.

alex_prodops: Short-term mitigation: reduce per-tenant concurrency and set rate-limit for embeddings route to 100 qps. Also enabling `proxy_buffering off` for streaming paths to avoid memory blowups.

vivian_eng: Long-term: add backpressure controls on batch size (max items per request), tune envoy upstream http2 settings (`max_concurrent_streams`) and increase midproxy worker threads. Also improve observability: emit per-tenant inflight request gauge and per-route buffer-usage metric.

jordan_sre: Action items:
- maria_support -> escalate to ACME, ask them to throttle to 100 qps and test
- alex_prodops -> deploy temporary rate-limit and `proxy_buffering off` config to canary edge
- vivian_eng -> capture pcap and thread dump from midproxy during repro window, collect envoy stats snapshots
- me (jordan_sre) -> set alert for envoy.upstream_rq_pending_overflow > 0 for 5m

maria_support: Will update customer and ask for repro window. Ticket updated with suggested throttle. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary config rollout started: edge-config/rlimit-embeds-v2 -> 2/3

vivian_eng: After canary, we see immediate drop in 504s on canary hosts. Still pending analysis on root cause but mitigation seems effective. Will keep thread updated.

maria_support: ACME confirms reduced errors when throttled. Closing for now pending deeper fix. Thanks team :pray:
